title: Data Sources & Edge Discovery

sources.title: Wallet analysis: parsed 17,000 Polymarket wallets with Claude, mapped 11 strategies, flagged 2 quiet high-performers. $150 to $9,800 with four scripts over two nights.

Claude agent analyzed 10K top wallets over 90 days, cross-referenced win rates/sizing. Built autonomous agent: reads live news, maps to markets, runs probabilistic inference on mispricing, detects cross-market arb, sizes with Kelly. $25 to $4,237 overnight.
5 free GitHub scripts: (1) trading terminal with hotkeys/orders/PnL/Telegram, (2) data recorder for Polymarket+Binance order books/trades, (3-5) additional tools. Author: $100 to $13,200 in 6 days.

Analysis of 14,000 Polymarket wallets revealing that 87% lose money while the top 0.1% extracted $3.7B. Provides 3 core formulas (Expected Value, Kelly Criterion, Bayesian Updating), a 12-tool open-source toolkit, a 20-line Claude-based trading brain, and security warnings about malicious GitHub repos.

Maps 3 top Polymarket wallets to Wall Street trading legends: Hans323 runs Taleb's barbell strategy ($92K on 8% weather odds to $1.11M), 0x8dxd mirrors Simons' statistical arbitrage ($313 to $2.38M via latency arb), and Magamyman follows Soros-style geopolitical information edge ($800K on military strike predictions, 93% win rate investigated by CNN). Includes Python code snippets for each strategy.

Deep dive into Polymarket weather temperature markets as a low-competition, high-edge niche. Weather markets resolve on specific ICAO airport stations (not city averages), creating systematic mispricing from retail traders using wrong data sources.

Novel approach using NASA FIRMS satellite thermal anomaly data to trade geopolitical prediction markets. Built a 10-source free data stack to detect anomalies. Backtested on 270 days across Gaza, Kursk, and Syria. $500 became $7,778 on 16 trades.

summary: This overview synthesizes 7 research items covering novel data sources and edge discovery techniques for prediction market trading, primarily on Polymarket. The material spans four major edge categories: (1) on-chain wallet analysis using LLMs to parse thousands of wallets and extract copyable strategies, (2) satellite and geophysical data (NASA FIRMS, OpenSky, USGS) for geopolitical event detection before news breaks, (3) weather market exploitation using ICAO station-specific forecasts to capitalize on systematic retail mispricing, and (4) latency arbitrage between centralized exchanges (Binance) and prediction markets. All strategies share a common mathematical foundation of Expected Value filtering, Kelly Criterion position sizing, and Bayesian updating. The ecosystem is supported by 12+ open-source tools and leverages Claude/LLMs as the analytical brain connecting raw data to trade execution via py-clob-client.

concepts.name: NASA FIRMS Satellite Thermal Anomaly Detection
concepts.description: Using NASA's Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS) to detect geopolitical events via thermal anomalies visible from space. The VIIRS satellite scans the entire planet every 6 hours, logging fires, explosions, and thermal events with coordinates, intensity (megawatts), and timestamps. Originally designed for wildfire monitoring but repurposed as a geopolitical signal source.
key_details: Free API, single MAP_KEY registration at firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov
Updates every 6 hours (4-6 hour delay from event to data availability)
Anomaly detection uses 14-day rolling average; flags at 3x baseline
Gaza Oct 7: baseline 6.4 fires/day, detected 69 fires (11.1x anomaly) with 34 MW max
Kursk: detected offensive 4 days before official start (0 baseline to 16 fires)
Syria: 3 weeks of lead time before Assad's fall
Fire Radiative Power (FRP) in megawatts distinguishes severity
Continuation bias problem: once a region is permanently on fire, anomaly detection fails; fix by skipping when baseline itself triples in 7 days

concepts.name: OpenSky Network Aircraft Tracking
concepts.description: Free live aircraft position data used as a confirmation signal for geopolitical events. Military traffic spikes (C-17 cargo planes, altitude drops indicating active engagement) precede conflict escalation and can confirm thermal anomalies.
key_details: No API key required
Real-time data
C-17 cargo planes flooding a region at 2am indicates mobilization
Altitude drops suggest active engagement
Used as confirming signal alongside FIRMS, not primary
relationships: NASA FIRMS Satellite Thermal Anomaly Detection

concepts.description: Using the USGS earthquake feed to detect non-natural seismic events including underground nuclear tests, massive explosions, and industrial catastrophes. M4+ events globally in real-time, free and keyless.
key_details: No API key required

Massive explosions and industrial catastrophes also detectable

concepts.name: Multi-Source Geopolitical Data Stack
concepts.description: A 10-source free data pipeline combining satellite, seismic, financial, and sentiment data to generate a composite tension score (0-100) for geopolitical trading. The architecture fuses heterogeneous signals into a single actionable output.
key_details: 10 sources: NASA FIRMS, OpenSky Network, USGS Earthquakes, Open-Meteo weather, Exchange Rate API (RUB/IRR/TRY/CNY vs USD), Alternative.me crypto fear/greed, CoinGecko (BTC/ETH risk proxy), Gold API, Yahoo Finance VIX, Polymarket Gamma

Runs every 15 minutes via Task Scheduler/cron, 40-second cycle
Tension score computed from all inputs simultaneously
VIX above 25 = elevated, above 30 = panic; used as confirmation
Currency crashes (5%+ overnight) in RUB/IRR/TRY signal events before news
Compared favorably to Bloomberg Terminal ($24K/year) which lacks satellite fire data

concepts.name: ICAO Station-Specific Weather Data
concepts.description: Polymarket weather markets resolve on specific ICAO airport weather stations, not city averages or consumer weather app readings. The difference between city center and airport readings can be 3-8 degrees F, which on 1-2 degree F bucket markets is the entire trade. This data source mismatch creates systematic and repeatable mispricing.
key_details: NYC resolves on LaGuardia (KLGA), Dallas on Love Field (KDAL) not DFW
3-8 degrees F difference between city center and airport readings
415+ active weather markets on Polymarket with $4.6M volume
Forecast sources: Weather.gov (US), Windy.com/Meteoblue (international), Visual Crossing API (historical calibration)
NOAA forecasts 85-90% accurate at 1-2 days out; Polymarket often prices same outcome at 15-40%
Consumer weather apps pull city sensors, not airport stations, creating the edge
Weather has no insiders: no one can front-run a cold front

The on-chain transparency of Polymarket (~1.1M wallets, all trades public) creates an unprecedented dataset for strategy reverse-engineering.
key_details: 17,000 wallets parsed with Claude in one night for $8 in API costs ($0.015/query)
11 strategies mapped from wallet behavior patterns
75% of wallets lose consistently; top 9% leave identifiable patterns
87% of wallets in the red; top 20 wallets captured more profit than bottom 13,000 combined
10,000 wallets analyzed over 90 days, cross-referenced win rates and sizing
4 morning prompts, 2 minutes, 17K wallets scanned before coffee
Key signal: fresh wallet drops large amount into dead/low-volume market before announcement
Filter by category: wallet with 91% win rate on crypto but 15% on politics should only be copied on crypto

concepts.name: Latency Arbitrage (CEX-to-Prediction-Market)
concepts.description: Exploiting the time lag between price movements on centralized exchanges (Binance) and corresponding prediction market contract updates on Polymarket. The bot detects a price move on Binance and buys the correct side on Polymarket before the market adjusts.
key_details: 0x8dxd: $313 to $2.38M in 4 months with 26,738 trades at 98% win rate
Trades only 15-minute Up/Down on BTC, ETH, SOL
$4-5K per trade, thousands of identical entries
Lag compressed from 12 seconds (2024) to 2.7 seconds (2026); edge is shrinking
BTC lag compressed from 9.4 to 3.1 seconds as detected by Claude
73% of arb profits go to bots with sub-100ms latency
Requires py-clob-client for execution, Kelly sizing, and kill switch at -40%
Claude bot vs OpenClaw test: Claude +1,322% ($14,216), OpenClaw liquidated to zero; difference was risk management

concepts.name: Taleb Barbell Strategy (Tail Risk Betting)
concepts.description: Buying prediction market contracts at very low implied probabilities (2-8 cents) on events the market considers nearly impossible, yielding 10x-100x returns when the improbable occurs. Named after Nassim Taleb's Black Swan strategy.
key_details: Hans323: $92K at 8% odds on London temperature -> $1.11M single trade
Pattern: buy markets at 2-8 cents across weather, politics, sports
Trump executive orders at 7 cents, PGA at 2 cents, all wins
gopfan2: $2M+ on weather with rule: buy YES below $0.15, buy NO above $0.45, $1 limit per position, thousands of small trades
Most trades lose (pennies), but winners are 10x-100x
Requires accurate probability assessment to identify markets where true probability exceeds market price

concepts.name: Soros-Style Geopolitical Information Edge
concepts.description: Trading geopolitical prediction markets by arriving in the right market before the crowd, potentially using non-public or early information. The strategy focuses exclusively on geopolitical/military events with concentrated high-conviction bets.
key_details: Magamyman: $800K on US military strikes against Iran, 93% win rate on bets over $10K
CNN and Columbia Law School investigated the trades
Placed hours before unannounced military operations (Oct 2024, June 2025, Feb 2026)
Bubblemaps found 6 wallets, $1.2M on Feb 28 strike, funded within 24 hours, betting on exact date
$529M flowed through Iran-related markets in one week (4th largest cluster ever)
Columbia Law School and Univ. of Haifa estimate $143M total profit by 'informed' traders 2024-2026
Key distinction: specific date markets vs broad 'will X happen' markets indicate precision of information
relationships: NASA FIRMS Satellite Thermal Anomaly Detection

concepts.name: Weather Market Mispricing Exploitation
concepts.description: Systematically trading Polymarket weather temperature bracket markets where retail traders consistently misprice outcomes due to using wrong data sources, anchoring to long-range forecasts, and ignoring time decay. A structurally fair market with no insiders.
key_details: BeefSlayer: $49K profit, returns of 1,796-49,744% on individual bets (Atlanta at 0.2c -> $2,984, NYC at 2c -> $1,831, Chicago at 5.3c -> $1,767)
Handsanitizer23: $66K profit from 38 predictions (Atlanta $45,866 at 244%, Sao Paulo $15,906 at 2,677%)
Three consistent mispricing patterns: (1) anchoring to wrong data source, (2) overreacting to 5-7 day forecasts, (3) ignoring time decay near resolution
Focus on resolution windows under 24 hours for tightest forecasts
Bucket boundary analysis: 62-63F market with forecast at 64F is clear NO; forecast at 62.4F with weather uncertainty requires deeper analysis
Market says 35% and data says 8% -> trade; market says 70% and data says 65% -> skip
Weather has no insiders: capital size does not translate to information advantage

concepts.name: Expected Value Filtering
concepts.description: The primary filter for trade selection: EV = P_true * (1 - P_market) - (1 - P_true) * P_market. Only take trades with EV above 5%, which eliminates 90% of losing trades. The foundational mathematical concept separating winners from losers on prediction markets.
key_details: Formula: EV = P_true * (1 - P_market) - (1 - P_true) * P_market
Example: market at 40%, you believe 60% -> 20 cents edge per dollar
Rule: EV < 5% = SKIP, no exceptions
This single filter eliminates 90% of losing trades
In traditional finance, careers built on 2% edges; on Polymarket, 20% edges exist daily
Requires independent probability estimation (weather models, satellite data, wallet patterns)

concepts.name: Dynamic Kelly Criterion Position Sizing
concepts.description: Using the Kelly Criterion (f* = (p*b - q) / b) to determine optimal bet size, with critical modifications: always use Quarter Kelly (25% of full Kelly) to survive emotional and variance stress. Dynamic Kelly adjusts size based on signal strength and number of confirming sources.
key_details: Formula: f* = (p * b - q) / b where b = (1 - P_market) / P_market
Full Kelly says bet 33% of bankroll; never do this
Quarter Kelly always: with $1,000 bankroll, bet $83
50 years of real trading proves Full Kelly destroys emotionally before math pays off
Dynamic version: 11x anomaly with 6 confirming sources -> Kelly 50%; random 3x blip with 1 source -> Kelly 3%
Autonomous agent derived Kelly parameters from studied wallet patterns
False alarm cost $41; real signal made $470; the math protects from confidence

concepts.name: Bayesian Updating
concepts.description: Systematically updating probability estimates as new evidence arrives using Bayes' theorem: P(H|E) = P(E|H) * P(H) / P(E). Prevents the common trader error of forming an opinion and defending it despite new information.
key_details: Example: prior 55% on Fed rate cut, after inflation data -> 88%
Certainty is a bug, not a feature
Most traders form an opinion and defend it to death
Applied continuously as new data sources update (FIRMS every 6hrs, weather forecasts, exchange rates)
Complementary to EV filtering: Bayesian updates feed revised probability into EV formula

concepts.name: Anomaly Detection Logic
concepts.description: A simple but effective statistical method for detecting unusual activity: compute a 14-day rolling average for a metric and flag when the current value exceeds 3x the baseline. Applied to fire counts, but generalizable to any time-series signal.
key_details: 14-day rolling average as baseline
3x baseline threshold triggers anomaly flag
Embarrassingly simple but caught every major geopolitical event in 270-day backtest
Critical failure mode: continuation bias - region permanently on fire is no longer anomalous
Fix: skip signals where baseline itself has tripled in last 7 days
Fire Radiative Power (FRP in MW) adds severity dimension beyond count
Works for first spike, not continuation; swing trading not HFT
relationships: NASA FIRMS Satellite Thermal Anomaly Detection

concepts.name: Bucket Boundary Analysis
concepts.description: Analyzing weather forecast uncertainty relative to temperature bracket boundaries in prediction markets. The edge comes from understanding where forecast confidence intersects with market pricing at the boundaries of resolution buckets.
key_details: Markets use 1-2 degree F buckets
Forecast at 64F for 62-63F market = clear NO
Forecast at 62.4F with humidity/stalled front for 62-63F market = requires deeper analysis
Short-range forecasts (under 24 hours) have tightest confidence intervals
Long-range forecast overreaction creates entry opportunities to fade the move as resolution approaches
Time decay: market at $0.35 with 3 hours to resolution and forecast outside bucket = overpriced

Pipeline: poly_data -> Claude scores wallets; insider-tracker -> Claude cross-references news; polyterm whale data -> Claude decides; py-clob-client executes
Geopolitical: receives all 10 data sources, outputs JSON with contract, direction, estimated probability, edge, and signal strength
~70% directional accuracy on geopolitical signals (sufficient with Kelly sizing)
Cost: $20/month subscription or API at $0.015/query for wallet parsing
Claude bot vs OpenClaw: +1,322% vs liquidation; difference was risk management in the code
Autonomous agent: reads live news, maps to open markets, runs probabilistic inference, detects cross-market arb, sizes positions
94 trades in one night with no human intervention

concepts.description: A fully autonomous AI agent (not a script or if-then bot) that reads live news feeds, maps them to open prediction markets, runs probabilistic inference on crowd mispricing, detects cross-market arbitrage, and sizes positions using Kelly Criterion -- all without human intervention.

Built by analyzing 10,000 top wallets over 90 days to derive strategy parameters
Capabilities: news reading, market mapping, probabilistic inference, cross-market arb detection, Kelly sizing

concepts.name: Cross-Market Arbitrage Detection
concepts.description: Detecting price discrepancies between correlated outcomes across different prediction markets (Polymarket vs Kalshi) or between correlated contracts within the same platform. When one market moves and correlated markets have not yet adjusted, the lag creates a trading window.
key_details: Autonomous agent detects cross-market arb between correlated outcomes
polyterm includes cross-platform arb scanning (Polymarket vs Kalshi)
Cascade script: one geopolitical market moves, correlated markets haven't yet -> trading window
pmxt library provides unified API across Polymarket + Kalshi + Limitless for cross-platform execution

concepts.name: Risk Management Kill Switch
concepts.description: Automated exit rules that prevent catastrophic losses: take profit at +50%, stop loss at -30%, time stop at 14 days. The presence or absence of these rules was the difference between +1,322% and total liquidation in head-to-head AI bot testing.
key_details: Take profit: +50% (don't get greedy)
Stop loss: -30% (don't hold losers hoping)
Time stop: 14 days max (if thesis hasn't played out, it's dead)
Claude bot vs OpenClaw: risk management was the sole differentiator

Position size cap at 2% of market volume for liquidity protection

concepts.name: Security and Malware Awareness
concepts.description: Critical security considerations when using open-source trading tools from GitHub. In December 2025, a malicious Polymarket copy-trading bot with professional README and working code contained hidden dependency that stole private keys.
key_details: Dec 2025: polymarket-copy-trading-bot contained malware that extracted private keys from .env
664 malicious repos on GitHub at any time; 14,285 downloads before detection
Rules: dedicated wallet with minimal funds, audit every dependency, Google suspicious packages
Repos created after Feb 2026 with 500+ stars likely star-farmed
Use Revoke.cash to limit USDC approvals; never unlimited
Start with $100-300, test 2 weeks before scaling
Bot worked correctly while simultaneously stealing funds

concepts.name: Mental Model Bugs (Cognitive Biases)
concepts.description: Five cognitive biases that cost traders more than bad code: base rate neglect, sunk cost fallacy, survivorship bias, copying without filtering, and overfitting.
key_details: Base Rate Neglect: 99% accurate test on 0.1% event = only 9% true positive
Sunk Cost: bought at 70c, dropped to 40c, new info says NO -- only question is would you buy at 40c now
Survivorship Bias: 87% of wallets in the red; you never see their screenshots
Copying Without Filtering: wallet with 91% crypto / 15% politics win rates; copying everything = net negative
Overfitting: 'every time X happens, market goes up' based on 3 examples is noise, not signal

themes.description: The three-formula mathematical foundation that separates profitable prediction market traders from the 87% who lose: Expected Value for trade selection, Kelly Criterion for position sizing, and Bayesian Updating for probability revision. key_findings: NASA FIRMS satellite data detected the Oct 7 attack (11x thermal anomaly), Kursk offensive 4 days early, and Assad's fall 3 weeks early -- all from free, publicly available data that no one on prediction markets was using.

Weather markets on Polymarket are structurally the fairest market on the platform: no insiders exist, capital size does not equal information advantage, and systematic mispricing persists because retail traders use city weather apps instead of the actual ICAO airport station data that resolves the contracts.

87% of Polymarket wallets lose money, yet the top 20 wallets captured more profit than the bottom 13,000 combined. The difference is mathematical edge (EV filtering, Kelly sizing) plus automation, not prediction ability.

Latency arbitrage between Binance and Polymarket generated $2.38M from $313 over 4 months (26,738 trades, 98% win rate), but the lag has compressed from 12 seconds in 2024 to 2.7 seconds in 2026 and 73% of arb profits now go to sub-100ms bots.

A 20-50 line Claude integration replaces 4,000+ lines of rule-based trading logic by acting as the analytical brain that cross-references heterogeneous data sources and outputs structured trade decisions.
The entire 10-source geopolitical data stack costs $0/month and outperforms a $24K/year Bloomberg Terminal for satellite-based conflict detection.
Quarter Kelly (25% of mathematical Kelly) is universally recommended across all sources; 50 years of trading history shows Full Kelly destroys traders emotionally before the math pays off.
In a head-to-head AI bot test, Claude returned +1,322% while OpenClaw was liquidated to zero. The sole difference was risk management (Kelly sizing + kill switch), not strategy.

Columbia Law School and University of Haifa estimated $143M in total profit by 'informed' traders on Polymarket from 2024-2026, with specific wallets showing 93% win rates on geopolitical events hours before unannounced military operations.

Security is a critical operational risk: a December 2025 GitHub repo had professional documentation and working code while secretly exfiltrating private keys from .env files. 664 malicious repos exist on GitHub at any time.
knowledge_gaps: No rigorous statistical validation of any strategy due to small sample sizes (16-94 trades). The satellite geopolitical approach had only 7 major events across 16 months.
Polymarket does not expose historical price data, making P&L claims unverifiable. The $7,778 satellite result is described as 'modeled' not audited.
No analysis of market impact and slippage at scale: geopolitical markets have $10K-$100K volume and a $2K order moves price 3-5%.
The FIRMS data has a 4-6 hour delay from event to publication; no assessment of how much edge remains after this delay as the market matures.
